Dear Sir(s),
This is to inform that an application under Section 147 of the Companies Act, 2017 was
submitted to the Securities & Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) for seeking further
extension in holding of the Company's Annual General Meeting (AGM) and laying of accounts
therein for theyear ended June 30,2022,on or before April 15,2023.
In this regard, SECP vide letter No.SMD/PRDD/Comp/(13)/2021/370 datedNovember
22, 2022 (copy enclosed) has directed the Company in terms of Section 147 of the Companies Act,
2017, to convene and hold its AGM for the year ended June 30,2022 and to lay therein audited
financial statements of the Company for shareholder's consideration at earliest by April 15, 2023.
You may please inform the TRE Certificate holders of the Exchange accordingly.
Thanks and regards.
Yours sincerely,
